+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_API = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class UnsafeSpan:
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    label: str
+    score: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RedactionResult:
+    text: str
+    spans: List[UnsafeSpan]
+    flagged: bool
+
+
+def _openai_headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def _moderate_with_openai(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_API,
+        headers=_openai_headers(),
+        json={"model": "omni-moderation-latest", "input": text},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def _extract_categories(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, bool]:
+    results = payload.get("results") or []
+    if not results:
+        return {}
+    categories = results[0].get("categories") or {}
+    return {str(k): bool(v) for k, v in categories.items()}
+
+
+def _extract_scores(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
+    results = payload.get("results") or []
+    if not results:
+        return {}
+    scores = results[0].get("category_scores") or {}
+    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in scores.items()}
+
+
+def redact_unsafe(text: str, redact_char: str = "█") -> RedactionResult:
+    payload = _moderate_with_openai(text)
+    categories = _extract_categories(payload)
+    scores = _extract_scores(payload)
+    spans: List[UnsafeSpan] = []
+
+    if any(categories.values()):
+        spans.append(
+            UnsafeSpan(
+                start=0,
+                end=len(text),
+                label=next((k for k, v in categories.items() if v), "unsafe"),
+                score=max(scores.values()) if scores else 1.0,
+            )
+        )
+
+    if not spans:
+        return RedactionResult(text=text, spans=[], flagged=False)
+
+    redacted = redact_char * len(text)
+    return RedactionResult(text=redacted, spans=spans, flagged=True)
+
+
+def flag_unsafe(text: str) -> bool:
+    return redact_unsafe(text).flagged
+
*** End Patch

+

+OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_batch(messages: Sequence[str], model: str = OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    token = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not token:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": model, "input": list(messages)},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    results = payload.get("results", [])
+
+    decisions: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for index, message in enumerate(messages):
+        result = results[index] if index < len(results) else {}
+        decisions.append(
+            {
+                "message": message,
+                "model": model,
+                "flagged": result.get("flagged", False),
+                "categories": result.get("categories", {}),
+                "category_scores": result.get("category_scores", {}),
+                "raw": result,
+            }
+        )
+    return decisions
+
+
+def moderate_batch_from_env(messages: Sequence[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    return moderate_batch(messages)

*** Begin Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_text(text: str, model: str = OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    token = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not token:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": model, "input": text},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    result = payload["results"][0]
+    return {
+        "model": model,
+        "flagged": result.get("flagged", False),
+        "categories": result.get("categories", {}),
+        "category_scores": result.get("category_scores", {}),
+        "raw": payload,
+    }
+
+
+def moderate_text_from_env(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return moderate_text(text)
